title: JSON syntax error
message: JSON syntax error: expected {expected}.
basic_text: This file isn't valid JSON, so Rastai can't read it.
fix_text: Fix the text at the line and column shown, or restore the file from a backup.

title: File is not valid UTF-8
message: The file is not valid UTF-8 text.
basic_text: This file contains bytes that aren't text, so Rastai can't read it.
fix_text: Save the file as UTF-8, or check that it is the file you meant to open.

title: Duplicate key in a JSON object
message: This object has the same key twice.
basic_text: A setting appears twice in this file, so Rastai can't tell which one you meant.
fix_text: Remove one of the two keys.

title: NaN or Infinity is not valid JSON
message: NaN, Infinity and numbers too large for a 64-bit float are not valid JSON.
basic_text: This file has a number that isn't a real number, such as NaN or Infinity.
fix_text: Replace it with a finite number, or with null where the field allows it.

title: Required field missing
message: Required field {field} is missing; it should be {expected}.
basic_text: Something this file needs is missing.
fix_text: Add the field shown.

title: Field has the wrong kind
message: {field} should be {expected}, but it is {found}.
basic_text: A value in this file is the wrong kind, for example text where a number belongs.
fix_text: Change the value to the kind shown.

title: Unknown field
message: Unknown field {field}.
basic_text: This file has a setting Rastai doesn't know. It may be a typo, or come from a newer version.
fix_text: Check the spelling, or remove the field.

title: Value is not one of the allowed values
message: {found} is not one of the allowed values; expected {expected}.
basic_text: A value in this file isn't one of the choices Rastai accepts.
fix_text: Change it to one of the allowed values.

title: The type field doesn't match the file extension
message: The type field says {type}, but the file extension is for {extension_type}.
basic_text: The file's name says one kind of file, but its contents say another.
fix_text: Rename the file with the right extension, or fix its type field.

title: A value can't be written as JSON
message: A value can't be written as JSON: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai hit an internal problem while saving. This is a bug, not something you did.
fix_text: Please report this bug; the log has the details.

title: Reference doesn't resolve
message: The reference {reference} doesn't resolve.
basic_text: Something in this file points to a part that doesn't exist.
fix_text: Fix the reference, or add the part it names.

title: Shapes don't match along a graph edge
message: {from_graph_node} gives shape {from_shape}, but {to_graph_node} expects {to_shape}.
basic_text: Two connected blocks in this design don't fit together.
fix_text: Change one block's size, or add a block between them that reshapes the data.

title: Graph has a cycle with no recurrent node
message: The graph has a cycle through {graph_nodes} with no recurrent graph node.
basic_text: This design loops back on itself, which only a recurrent block can do.
fix_text: Remove one connection in the loop, or make one of its blocks recurrent.

title: Input ranges overlap
message: Input {input_name} overlaps input {other_input_name} ({other_range}).
basic_text: Two inputs claim the same part of the data.
fix_text: Shrink one of the ranges, or merge the two inputs.

title: Duplicate id
message: The id {id} is used more than once.
basic_text: Two items in this file have the same name, so Rastai can't tell them apart.
fix_text: Rename one of them.

title: Value isn't in its required form
message: {found} isn't {expected}.
basic_text: A value in this file is written in a form Rastai can't use, such as a color that isn't six hex digits.
fix_text: Rewrite the value in the form shown.

title: File requires a plugin that isn't installed or enabled
message: This file needs the plugin {plugin_id} ({range}), which isn't installed or enabled.
basic_text: This file uses a plugin you don't have turned on.
fix_text: Install or enable the plugin, then open the file again.

title: No handler for this file type
message: No installed handler opens {extension} files.
basic_text: Rastai doesn't know how to open this kind of file.
fix_text: Install a plugin that handles this file type.

title: Model has more parameters than the dataset has tokens
message: The model has {parameter_count} parameters, but the dataset has only {token_count} tokens.
basic_text: This model is very large for this much data, so it will likely memorize instead of learn.
fix_text: Use a smaller model, or more data.

title: File from a newer schema version; opened read-only
message: This file is from schema version {version}; this version of Rastai reads up to {current_version}, so it opens read-only.
basic_text: This file was made by a newer version of Rastai. You can look at it but not change it.
fix_text: Update Rastai to edit it.

title: Migration step failed
message: Upgrading this file from schema version {from_version} failed: {reason}.
basic_text: This file is from an older version of Rastai and couldn't be upgraded.
fix_text: Open it with the version that made it, or report the problem.

title: Zip entry escapes its folder (zip slip)
message: The zip entry {entry_name} would be written outside its folder; the archive is refused.
basic_text: This archive tries to put a file somewhere it shouldn't, so Rastai won't open it.
fix_text: Only open archives from sources you trust, and ask the sender for a fixed copy.

title: Zip exceeds size or ratio caps (zip bomb)
message: The zip expands past the import limits: {reason}.
basic_text: This archive would unpack into far more data than it looks like, so Rastai won't open it.
fix_text: Only open archives from sources you trust.

title: File is larger than the import limit
message: The file is {size_bytes} bytes; the import limit is {limit_bytes} bytes.
basic_text: This file is bigger than Rastai will read in one go.
fix_text: Split the file, or use a smaller one.

title: JSON nested deeper than the import limit
message: The JSON is nested deeper than the limit of {limit_depth} levels.
basic_text: This file is nested too deeply to read safely.
fix_text: Flatten the file's structure.

title: Graph has more nodes or parameters than the import limit
message: The graph has more graph nodes or parameters than the import limit ({limit}).
basic_text: This model design is larger than Rastai will import.
fix_text: Import a smaller model.

title: JSON has more values than the import limit
message: The JSON has more than {limit_count} values.
basic_text: This file holds more items than Rastai will read safely at once.
fix_text: Split the file into smaller ones.

title: Safetensors: file is shorter than the 8-byte header length
message: Safetensors: the file is shorter than the 8-byte header length.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: header length points past the end of the file
message: Safetensors: the header length ({header_bytes} bytes) points past the end of the file.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: header is over the 100 MB limit
message: Safetensors: the header is {header_bytes} bytes, over the 100 MB limit.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: header is not valid UTF-8 JSON
message: Safetensors: the header is not valid UTF-8 JSON (this includes NaN and trailing bytes).
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: header is not a JSON object
message: Safetensors: the header is not a JSON object.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: header has duplicate keys
message: Safetensors: the header has the key {key} twice.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: a tensor entry is not an object
message: Safetensors: the entry for tensor {tensor_name} is not an object.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: unsupported dtype
message: Safetensors: tensor {tensor_name} has the unsupported dtype {dtype}.
basic_text: This weights file uses a number format Rastai can't read.
fix_text: Convert the weights to a supported dtype, such as bf16, fp16 or fp32.

title: Safetensors: shape is not a list of non-negative integers
message: Safetensors: the shape of tensor {tensor_name} is not a list of non-negative integers.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: data_offsets is not two integers
message: Safetensors: data_offsets of tensor {tensor_name} is not two integers.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: data_offsets fall outside the data section
message: Safetensors: data_offsets of tensor {tensor_name} fall outside the data section (reversed, past the end, or beyond 64 bits).
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: the shape's byte size overflows 64 bits
message: Safetensors: the byte size of tensor {tensor_name}'s shape overflows 64 bits.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: the shape's byte size doesn't match the offsets
message: Safetensors: tensor {tensor_name}'s shape needs {expected_bytes} bytes, but its offsets hold {found_bytes}.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: tensors overlap
message: Safetensors: tensors {tensor_name} and {other_tensor_name} overlap.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: gap in the data section
message: Safetensors: the data section has a gap at byte {offset}.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: bytes at the end belong to no tensor
message: Safetensors: the last {extra_bytes} bytes belong to no tensor.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: Safetensors: __metadata__ must map strings to strings
message: Safetensors: __metadata__ must map strings to strings.
basic_text: This weights file is damaged or isn't a valid safetensors file.
fix_text: Download or export the file again.

title: GGUF: not a GGUF file
message: GGUF: not a GGUF file (bad magic).
basic_text: This GGUF model file is damaged, or isn't a GGUF file Rastai can read.
fix_text: Download the file again, or pick another GGUF file.

title: GGUF: unsupported version
message: GGUF: version {version} is not supported; only version 3 is read.
basic_text: This GGUF file uses a version Rastai can't read.
fix_text: Convert it with a current llama.cpp, or pick another file.

title: GGUF: header ends before its declared key-values or tensor infos
message: GGUF: the header ends before its declared key-values or tensor infos.
basic_text: This GGUF model file is damaged, or isn't a GGUF file Rastai can read.
fix_text: Download the file again, or pick another GGUF file.

title: GGUF: a count, string or array length is over the import limit
message: GGUF: a count, string or array length ({count}) is over the import limit.
basic_text: This GGUF model file is damaged, or isn't a GGUF file Rastai can read.
fix_text: Download the file again, or pick another GGUF file.

title: GGUF: unknown value type or tensor type
message: GGUF: unknown value type or tensor type {type_id}.
basic_text: This GGUF model file is damaged, or isn't a GGUF file Rastai can read.
fix_text: Download the file again, or pick another GGUF file.

title: GGUF: a tensor's data lies outside the file
message: GGUF: the data of tensor {tensor_name} lies outside the file.
basic_text: This GGUF model file is damaged, or isn't a GGUF file Rastai can read.
fix_text: Download the file again, or pick another GGUF file.

title: Model type not recognized; imported as one opaque graph node
message: config.json has no model_type or architectures; the model is imported as one opaque graph node.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't recognize this model's architecture, so it shows it as one sealed block.
fix_text: You can still run it; install a plugin with a family for this model to see inside it.

title: Unsupported config feature or unmapped tensors; the owning block is opaque
message: {block_name} uses an unsupported config feature or has unmapped tensors ({detail}); it is imported as opaque.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't map part of this model, so that part shows as a sealed block.
fix_text: The rest of the model works as usual; you can inspect the sealed block at its edges.

title: The repository declares remote code; Rastai never runs it
message: The repository declares remote code (auto_map); Rastai never runs it.
basic_text: This model comes with its own Python code. Rastai never runs downloaded code.

title: The .pt2 archive holds pickled data; refused
message: The .pt2 archive {path} holds pickled data; it is refused.
basic_text: This file contains pickled Python data, which can run code when it loads, so Rastai refuses it.
fix_text: Export the model with safetensors weights instead.

title: An ONNX op has no ModelSpec mapping; imported as opaque
message: The ONNX op {op_type} has no ModelSpec mapping; it is imported as opaque.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't map one operation of this model, so it shows as a sealed block.

title: Weight shapes don't match the config; compile refused
message: Tensor {tensor_name} has shape {found_shape}, but the config needs {expected_shape}; compile refused.
basic_text: These weights don't belong to this model's configuration.
fix_text: Check that the weights and config.json come from the same model.
